Text: Meta Platforms is reshuffling its communications and public affairs leadership, promoting veteran executive Tucker Bounds to lead global communications while former chief David Ginsberg moves into an AI-focused product role, according to internal memos obtained by Axios. Ginsberg will become Vice President of Product and Innovation in Insights, working with Chief Data Officer Alex Schultz to explore how AI can improve user research and product-development workflows. He joined Meta in 2017 to lead research and previously guided public affairs through several major regulatory and corporate crises. The changes reflect Meta’s broader shift toward AI, including its Muse personalized AI assistant and continued development of open-source models. $META
